action: @Mimi hums the gentle C5–E5–G5 motif. @Mochi tilts closer and joins the same closed-mouth wordless tune; @Hina joins with a tiny wing lift. One star point warms for Mimi, another for Mochi, a third for Hina. Keep all five points visible and distinct.
camera: Wide semicircle shot, 45mm, plush eye-level, fixed; all five friends have equal scale.
audio: One wordless hum, then two more in gentle harmony. Sparse celesta only, not covering the hum.
end_state: Three points show slightly stronger gold light.

action: @Tora joins with a brave but quiet wordless hum, shoulders softening. @Sora joins last with a gentle closed-mouth tone and one small flipper lift. The fourth and fifth points warm. Everyone subtly sways in place, feet grounded except blue hovering friend.
camera: Hard cut to medium-wide 55mm on the same axis, all five in frame; tiny focus shifts motivated by joins, no orbit.
audio: Five small wordless humming voices blend, C5–E5–G5 contour. No syllables, dialogue or lyrics.
end_state: All five points are luminous; all five friends are helping.

action: @Star now lifts smoothly off the moss and hovers at friends’ chest height between them. The five keep humming and look at it together; @Mochi’s and @Hina’s paws hover near but do not touch. A slow soft gold breathing pulse lights their cheeks. End with the star suspended steadily, ready to move toward the slope.
camera: Hard cut to slightly wider 40mm, an extremely slow small dolly back creates breathing space; finish camera still by 16s.
audio: Soft five-voice wordless harmony and a warm three-note celesta answer.
end_state: One fully lit star floats unsupported at chest height inside the five-friend arc.
